description.text: Geology is a natural science that studies the material composition, internal structure, external morphology, evolutionary history and various geological processes of the Earth. It takes the Earth as its research object, exploring the formation and evolution laws of the Earth, involving multiple dimensions such as rocks, minerals, strata, tectonic movements, geological disasters, and resource distribution. It is a discipline that closely combines theory with practice.

duration.text: The Geology at Northwest University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.
